name: cook-it
description: Follow recipes one step at a time, adjust servings, and find meals from pantry ingredients.

interface.longDescription: Cook from a recipe you provide or find a meal from the ingredients you have. Cook-It gives you one step at a time, answers questions without advancing the recipe, and scales servings as you cook. This version runs in chat and does not connect to the offline Cook-It app or its recipe library.
defaultPrompt: Guide me through making tortilla de patatas for four, one step at a time.
I have eggs, potatoes and onions. What can I cook?
